## ITR-2 User Manual

# ITR-2 User Manual

#### 1. Overview

The filing of **ITR-2** service is available to registered users on the e-Filing portal. This service enables individual taxpayers and HUFs to file ITR-2 through the e-Filing portal. This user manual covers the process for filing ITR-2 through online mode.

#### 2. Prerequisites for availing this service

|  |
| --- |
| **General** |
| * Registered user on the e-filing portal with valid user ID and password * Status of PAN is active * One validated bank account on e-filing portal * Access to verification methods: Aadhaar OTP/ DSC/ EVC through net banking or Bank account or demat account |
| **Other** |
| * PAN is linked with Aadhaar (recommended). |

#### 

#### 3. Form at a Glance

ITR-2 has the following sections that you need to fill (applicable schedule) before submitting the form:

3.1      Part A General   
 3.2      Schedule Salary   
 3.3      Schedule House Property  
 3.4      Schedule Capital Gains   
 3.5      Schedule 112A and Schedule-115AD(1)(iii) proviso  
 3.6      Schedule VDA  
 3.7      Schedule Other Sources  
 3.8      Schedule CYLA  
 3.9      Schedule BFLA  
 3.10    Schedule CFL  
 3.11    Schedule VI-A  
 3.12    Schedule 80G and Schedule 80GGA  
 3.13    Schedule AMT  
 3.14    Schedule AMTC  
 3.15    Schedule SPI  
 3.16    Schedule SI  
 3.17    Schedule EI  
 3.18    Schedule PTI  
 3.19    Schedule FSI  
 3.20    Schedule TR  
 3.21    Schedule FA  
 3.22    Schedule 5A  
 3.23    Schedule AL  
 3.24    Part B – Total Income (TI)  
 3.25    Tax Paid  
 3.26    Part B-TTI

**3.1 Part A General**

In the **Part a General** section of the ITR, you need to verify the pre-filled data from your e-Filing profile. You will not be able to edit some of your personal data directly in the form. However, you can make the necessary changes by going to your e-Filing profile.

You can edit your contact details, filing status, residential status and bank details in the form itself.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/1_71.png)

**1. Personal Information:**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/2_72.png)

**2. Contact Details:**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/3_65.png)

**3. Filing Status:**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/4_63.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/5_51.png)

**Note 1:**  
 In filing section **‘Filed u/s 139(1)’** will be auto selected. For AY 2026-27 New Tax Regime is the default Tax Regime and ‘No’ will be Auto selected.  
 If you want to opt out of New Tax Regime Select ‘Yes’, Select **‘Residential Status in India’** and **‘Conditions for Residential Status’** from the drop-down menu.

**Note 2:**  
 The Finance Act 2023 has amended the provisions of Section 115BAC to make it the default tax regime for the assessee being an Individual and HUF. If an assessee does not want to pay tax according to the new tax regime, he will have to explicitly opt out of it and choose to be taxed under the old tax regime.

An assessee having income from a business or profession can  opt out of the new tax regime and switch to the old tax regime for a relevant year. However, he has to exercise this option in Form No. 10-IEA on or before the due date for filing the return of income under Section 139(1).

**4. Bank Details:**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/6_52.png)

**3.2 Schedule Salary**

In **Schedule Salary,** you need to review / enter / edit details of your income from salary/pension, exempt allowances and deductions u/s 16.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/7_46.png)

**3.3 Schedule House Property**

In **Schedule House Property,** you need to review / enter / edit details relating to house property (self-occupied, let out, or deemed let out). The details include co-owner details, tenant details, rent, interest, pass through income etc.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/8_48.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/9_44.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/10_54.png)

**3.4 Schedule CG – Capital Gains**

**Capital Gains** arising from sale / transfer of different types of capital assets have been segregated. In a case where capital gains arise from sale or transfer of more than one capital asset, which are of same type, please make a consolidated computation of capital gains in respect of all such capital assets of same type. But in case of transfer of land / building, it is mandatory to enter the computation towards each land / building. In **Schedule Capital Gains,** you need to enter details of your Short-Term and Long-Term Capital Gains / Losses for all types of Capital Assets owned.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/11_52.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/12_50.png)

**3.5 Schedule 112A and Schedule-115AD(1)(iii) proviso**

• In **Schedule 112A,** you need to review / enter / edit details about sale of equity shares of a company, an equity-oriented fund, or a unit of a business trust on which STT is paid.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/13_50.png)

• **Schedule 115AD (1)(iii) proviso** involves entering the same details as for Schedule 112A but is applicable to non-residents.

(In personal information filing section, a new field is inserted - Whether you are an FPI? If yes, provide SEBI Registration Number. If the taxpayer has selected ‘Yes’, then Schedule 115AD should be enabled.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/14_44.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/15_42.png)

**Note:** If shares are bought on or before 31st January 2018, it is mandatory to enter Scrip-wise details of each transfer under Schedule 112A and Schedule-115AD(1)(iii) proviso.

**3.6 Schedule VDA**

In **Virtual digital Asset schedule,** you need to add the income from transfer of virtual digital assets. Schedule VDA (Virtual Digital Asset) has been newly inserted. It’s income auto-populates in Schedule CG.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/16_42.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/17_41.png)

**3.7 Schedule Other Sources**

In **Schedule Other Sources,** you need to review / enter / edit details of all your income from other sources, including (but not limited to) income charged at special rates, deductions u/s 57 and income involving racehorses.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/18_42.png)

**3.8 Schedule Current Year’s Loss Adjustment (CYLA)**

In **Schedule Current Year’s Loss Adjustment (CYLA),** you will be able to view details of income after set-off of current year losses. The unabsorbed losses allowed to be carried forward out of this are taken to Schedule CFL for carry forward to future years.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/19_34.png)

**3.9 Schedule Brought Forward Loss Adjustment (BFLA)**

In **Schedule Brought Forward Loss Adjustment (BFLA),** you can view the details of income after set-off of brought forward losses of earlier years.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/20_33.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/21_31.png)

**3.10 Schedule Carry Forward Losses (CFL)**

In **Schedule Carry Forward Losses (CFL),** you can view the details of losses to be carried forward to future years.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/22.1.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/22.2.png)

**3.11 Schedule VI-A**

In **Schedule VI-A,** you need to add and verify any deductions you need to claim under Section 80 - Parts B, C, CA, and D (subsections as specified below) of the Income Tax Act.

**Part B- Deduction in respect of certain payments:**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/23_28.png)

**Part C, CA, and D – Deduction in respect of other incomes/other deductions:**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/24_24.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/25_20.png)

**Please Note:** Default Regime is New Tax Regime. If you have not opted for Old Tax Regime, only Deductions under Section 80CCD (2)- Employers Contribution to Tier-1 NPS Account and Section 80CCH- amount deposited in the Agniveer Corpus Fund will be enabled.

**3.12 Schedule 80G and Schedule 80GGA**

In **Schedule 80G and Schedule 80GGA,** you need to provide details of details of donations entitled for deduction under Section 80G and Section 80GGA.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/26_18.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/27_15.png)

**3.13 Schedule AMT**

In **Schedule AMT,** you need to confirm the computation of Alternate Minimum Tax payable u/s 115JC.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/28_13.png)

**3.14 Schedule AMTC**

In **Schedule AMTC,** you need to add details of tax credits u/s 115JD.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/29_13.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/30_10.png)

**3.15 Schedule SPI**

In **Schedule SPI,** you need to add the income of specified persons (e.g. spouse, minor child) that is includable or required to be clubbed with your income as per Section 64.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/31_11.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/32_8.png)

**3.16 Schedule SI**

In **Schedule SI,** you will be able to view the income that is chargeable to tax at special rates. The amount under various income types is taken from the amounts provided in the relevant Schedules i.e., Schedule OS, Schedule BFLA.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/33_11.png)

**3.17 Schedule Exempt Income (EI)**

In **Schedule Exempt Income (EI),** you need to provide your details of exempt income i.e., income not to be included in total income or not chargeable to tax. The income types included in this schedule include interest, dividend, agricultural income, any other exempt income, income not chargeable to tax through DTAA, and pass through income which is not chargeable to tax.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/34_9.png)

**3.18 Schedule Pass Through Income (PTI)**

In **Schedule Pass Through Income (PTI),** you need to provide details of pass-through income received from business trust or investment fund as referred to in section 115UA or 115UB.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/35_8.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/36_7.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/37_7.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/38_7.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/39_6.png)

**3.19 Schedule FSI**

In **Schedule Foreign Source Income (FSI),** you need to report the details of income, which is accruing or arising from any source outside India. This schedule is available for residents only.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/40_6.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/41_5.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/42_7.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/43_7.png)

**3.20 Schedule TR**

In **Schedule TR,** you need to provide a summary of tax relief which is being claimed in India for taxes paid outside India in respect of each country. This schedule captures a summary of detailed information furnished in Schedule FSI.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/44_5.png)

**3.21 Schedule FA**

In **Schedule FA,** you need to provide details of foreign asset or income from any source outside India. This schedule need not be filled up if you are Not Ordinarily Resident or a Non-Resident.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/45_5.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/46_5.png)

**3.22 Schedule 5A**

In **Schedule 5A,** you need to provide the information necessary for apportionment of income between husband and wife if you are governed by the system of community of property under the Portuguese Civil Code 1860.

**3.23 Schedule AL**

If your total income exceeds ₹1 crore, it is mandatory to disclose the details of movable and immovable assets in **Schedule AL** along with liabilities incurred in relation to such assets. If you are a non-resident or resident but not ordinarily resident, only the details of assets located in India are to be mentioned.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/47_5.png)

**3.24 Part B – Total Income (TI)**

In the **Part B – Total Income (TI)** section, you will be able to view your computation of total income auto-populated from all the schedules you filled in the form.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/48_5.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/49_3.png)

**3.25 Tax Paid**

In the **Tax Paid** section, you need to verify your tax details as paid by you in the previous financial year. Tax details include TDS from Salary / TDS from Income Other than Salary, TCS, Advance Tax and Self-Assessment Tax.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/50_3.png)

**3.26 Part B-TTI**

In the **Part B-TTI** section, you will be able to view the overall computation of total income tax liability on total income.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/51_4.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/52_4.png)

#### 4. How to Access and Submit (Online Mode)

You can file and submit your ITR through following methods:

•    Online Mode – Through e-Filing portal   
 •    Offline Mode – Through Offline Utility

You can refer to the **Offline Utility (for ITRs)** user manual to learn more.

Follow the below steps to file and submit the ITR through **online mode:**

**Step 1:** Log in to the e-Filing portal using your user ID and password.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/53_4.png)

**Step 2:** On your Dashboard, click **‘e-File’ > ‘Income Tax Returns’ > ‘File Income Tax Return’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/54_4.png)

**Step 3:** Select **Assessment Year** as **2026–27.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/55_4.png)

**Step 4:** Select **Mode of Filing** as Online and click **Continue.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/56_2.png)

In case you have already filled out the Income Tax Return and it is pending for submission, click **‘Resume Filing’.** In case you wish to discard the saved return and start preparing the return afresh click **‘Start New Filing’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/57_3.png)

**Step 5:** Select **Status** as applicable to you and click on **‘Proceed’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/58_3.png)

**Step 6:** You have two options to select the type of Income Tax Return Form:

• If you are not sure which ITR to file, you may select **‘Help me decide which ITR Form to file’** and click **‘Proceed’.** Once the system helps you determine the correct ITR, you can proceed with filing your ITR.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/59_2.png)

• If you are sure which ITR to file, select **‘I know which ITR Form I need to file’,** Select the applicable income tax return form from the dropdown menu and click **‘Proceed with ITR’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/60_2.png)

**Note:**

• In case you are not aware which ITR or schedules are applicable to you or income and deductions details, your answers in response to a set of questions will guide you in determining the same and help you in correct / error free filing of ITR.

• In case you are aware of the ITR or schedules applicable to you or income and deductions details, you can skip the questions.

**Step 7:** Once you have selected the ITR applicable to you, note the list of documents needed and click **‘Let’s Get Started’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/61_2.png)

**Step 8:** Review your pre-filled data and edit it if necessary. Enter the remaining / additional data (if required). Click **‘Confirm’** at the end of each section.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/62_2.png)

**Step 9:** Enter your income and deduction details in the different sections. After completing and confirming all the sections of the form, click on **Proceed to verification.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/63_1.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/64_2.png)

**Step 10a:** Check Schedule **Part B- TTI,** in **case there is a tax liability**

You will be shown a summary of your tax computation in **Schedule Part B TTI** based on the details provided by you. If there is tax liability payable based on the computation, you will get the **‘Pay Now’** and **‘Pay Later’** options at the bottom of the page.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/65_1.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/66_1.png)

**Note:**

•    It is recommended to use the **‘Pay Now’** option.   
 •    If you opt to **‘Pay Later’**, you can make the payment after filing your Income Tax Return, but there is a risk of being considered as an assessee in default, and liability to pay interest on tax payable may arise.

**Step 10b:** In Part B- TTI, in case there is no tax liability (No Demand / No Refund) or if you are eligible for a Refund. Click ‘Confirm’.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/67_1.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/68_0.png)

**Step 11:** On selecting Pay now option you will see a pop-up message saying that you will be redirected to e-Pay Tax Service for Tax Payments. Click **‘Continue’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/69_0.png)

**Step 12:** After successful payment through e-Filing portal, a success message is displayed. Click **‘Return to Filing’** to complete filing of ITR.

**Step 13:** Click **‘Proceed to Verification’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/70_0.png)![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/71_0.png)

**Step 14:** On the **‘Preview and Submit Your Return’** page, enter **‘Place’**, select the declaration checkbox and click **‘Proceed to Validation’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/72_0.png)

**Note:** If you have not involved a tax return preparer or TRP in preparing your return, you can leave the textboxes related to TRP blank.

**Step 15:** Internal validation is successful, click on **‘Preview’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/73_3.png)

**Step 16:** On your **‘Preview and Submit your Return’** page, click **‘Proceed to Validation’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/74_2.png)

Now, **Upload level validation** is successful, Click on **‘Proceed to Verification’.**

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/75_1.png)

**Note:** If you are shown a list of errors in your return, you need to go back to the form to correct the errors. If there are no errors, you can proceed to e-Verify your return by clicking **‘Proceed to Verification’.**

**Step 17:** On the **‘Complete your Verification’ page, select your preferred option** and click **‘Continue’.**

It is mandatory to verify your return, and e-Verification (recommended option – **e-Verify Now**) is the easiest way to verify your ITR – it is quick, paperless, and safer than sending a signed physical ITR-V to CPC by post.

![Data responsive](/iec/foportal/sites/default/files/inline-images/76_0.png)

**Note:** In case you select **‘e-Verify Later’**, you can submit your return, however, you will be required to verify your return within 30 days of filing of your ITR.

**Note:**

• Refer to **How to e-Verify** user manual to learn more.  
 • If you select **Verify via ITR-V**, you need to send a signed physical copy of your ITR-V to Centralized Processing Center, Income Tax Department, Bengaluru 560100 by speed post within 30 days.  
 • Please make sure you have pre-validated your bank account and link your PAN with the Aadhaar so that any refunds due maybe credited to your bank account.  
 • Refer to **My Bank Account** User Manual to learn more.

Once you e-Verify your return, a success message is displayed along with the Transaction ID and Acknowledgment Number. You will also receive a confirmation message on your mobile number and email ID registered on the e-Filing portal.
